lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to turn keys and sprites into a playable instrument with events, and sync animations to the music with messages.
Give each key its own script: “when a key pressed” → play a note.
Now the keyboard is a piano!
Sprites can be instruments too: “when this sprite clicked” → start a drum sound and change size for a bounce.
A band leader can broadcast “beat” in a loop.
Dancers receive it and change costume — everyone stays in time.
Scripts run in parallel: a drum loop, a melody and a dancer can all play at the same time.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
